'''Massin''' served as a [[Chief/Legends|Chief]] on the [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|Republic Assault Ship]] ''[[Leveler]]'' under [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], they escorted young [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] to her cabin.
